summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PURE LIFE OS Phase 4 features: Weazel News 2.0 (workflow, RBAC, breaking news), Service Chat 2.0 (channels, messaging, presence), Push Notifications (VAPID, subscribe/unsubscribe). All 24 backend tests pass. Frontend features working correctly.
passed_tests: GET /api/v2/news/published - Returns published articles with correct structure
GET /api/v2/news/breaking - Returns only breaking news articles
POST /api/v2/news/newsroom/{id}/approve - Editor+ can approve, Reporter denied
POST /api/v2/news/newsroom/{id}/publish - Caporedattore+ can publish, Reporter denied
GET /api/chat/channels - Returns accessible channels (6 channels for admin)
GET /api/chat/presence - Returns list of online users
UI: TopBar shows Weazel News, Redazione News, Service Chat links in menu
UI: News public page shows published articles with BREAKING badge
UI: News public page category selector works with all 7 categories
UI: News Editor page shows stats bar (Bozze, In Revisione, Approvati, Pubblicati, Breaking)
UI: News Editor page has tabs (I MIEI ARTICOLI, DA REVISIONARE, TUTTI GLI ARTICOLI)
UI: News Editor new article modal has all fields (Titolo, Sottotitolo, Categoria, Contenuto, etc.)
UI: Service Chat shows channels list (LSPD, EMS, GOVERNO, CENTRALE OPERATIVA, WEAZEL NEWS, STAFF)
UI: Service Chat presence status selector works (Online, In Servizio, Fuori Servizio)
UI: Service Chat message sending and display works
UI: Service Chat shows Utenti Online and AZIONI RAPIDE sections
critical_code_review_comments: All Phase 4 features implemented correctly with proper RBAC
News workflow: draft -> review -> approved -> published with role-based permissions
Chat channels properly filtered by sector access
Push notifications VAPID key endpoint public, subscribe/unsubscribe require auth
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_features.py - Created comprehensive test suite for Phase 4 features
seed_data_creation: Test articles created during testing (prefixed with TEST_) for workflow verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 features fully functional: 1) Weazel News 2.0 with complete workflow (draft->review->approved->published), RBAC (Reporter can only create/submit, Editor can approve, Caporedattore+ can publish), breaking news toggle, public news page with category filter. 2) Service Chat 2.0 with sector-based channels (LSPD, EMS, GOV, DISPATCH, NEWS, STAFF), presence status (online/in_service/off_duty), message sending/receiving. 3) Push Notifications with VAPID public key endpoint, subscribe/unsubscribe endpoints. TopBar menu includes links to Weazel News, Redazione News, and Service Chat.
